verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a documentation and SDK platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a first-party feature for acting on many pages or items at once. Fern Agent's ability to make described repository changes (fern-docs-29) is a general editing capability, not a documented bulk operation, and the multi-page 'Move the SDK guides…' line is only an example prompt. Generated-SDK pagination helpers and JSON-piping generated CLIs are developer building blocks, not a bulk capability of Fern itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
